decisions.reason: After two years without visible market presence, these modular extensions appear to have yielded enough information to suggest weak standalone traction, so their option value is lower than the value of reallocating resources to core engineering and newer projects.

Even with reduced visibility, the waste-oil-to-energy plant remains a core, knowledge-intensive flagship close to the firm's strategic direction, so management would likely keep this option open a bit longer because project-based demand may still emerge at limited holding cost.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is strategically relevant but its prolonged absence from the website, combined with higher commercialization and technical uncertainty, suggests the firm has learned enough to justify abandoning it as a marketed product and redeploying effort elsewhere.
